Hi:

There are a few such themes available at
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/themes/ .
Using a Google search, I found another set at
http://sape.inf.usi.ch/quick-reference/ggplot2/themes .

Also see the help page of opts() for 0.9.0:
http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/docs/opts.html
and the wiki page for opts():
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/-opts%28%29-List

HTH,
Dennis
